links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level) of chatbot-generated patient education materials
links.effect: Gemini FRE 65 vs ChatGPT 54; FKGL 7.58 vs 8.64. Both are above a 6th-grade level, and ChatGPT was harder to read.
links.quote: ChatGPT scored significantly higher on accuracy [9.00 vs. 8.00; P = 0.021] and perceived trustworthiness, while Gemini outperformed in readability (Flesch Reading Ease score: 65 vs. 54; Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level: 7.58 vs. 8.64) and clarity.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates and compares the accuracy, validity, and readability of patient education materials generated by two LLMs (ChatGPT and Gemini) for a clinical procedure, but does not test a specific deployment guardrail or practice.
